definition: MostRealUnique requires any two candidates possessing every positive feature to be equal. This is an explicit stronger sufficient reconstruction of Kant’s “does not differ” claim; identity is not inferred from qualitative sameness without this premise.
note: Analyst’s explicit reconstruction for the Kant inquiry (#250), not an assertion that the surrogate exhausts the historical concept. Source fidelity and the missing philosophical bridges are discussed in docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
